resources.string: Choose the touch movement control for this MIDlet.
The D-pad is available as a touch control.
Show an 8-way D-pad. Move or resize it in the virtual controls layout editor.
Show an analog stick. Move or resize it in the virtual controls layout editor.

Drag controls to move them. For buttons, move two fingers horizontally or vertically to change width or height, or diagonally to change both. Pinch to resize the D-pad or analog stick proportionally. Tap Done when finished.
Virtual controls edit mode: drag to move and use two fingers to resize.

Use the D-pad or left stick to navigate JL-Mod Plus, A to activate, and B to go back. During MIDlet runtime, physical keyboard/keypad/gamepad buttons use the same Key Mappings. Map any physical button to M if you want it to open the runtime MIDlet menu. Analog sticks, triggers, pointer input, calibration, and virtual controls are configured separately.
